notes.title: Introducing Beyond The Evil: Director's Cut
notes.content:
THE DIRECTOR'S CUT


What's up gamers! It's been a minute since we came with fresh news to the players. Today we're happy to announce that a new version of the game is coming: The Director's Cut! The release date will be announced in the future with the partnership of QuByte Interactive. Check it out what's new!


What's New?
New scenes are coming to the game, graphics remaster & more, bringing more variety to the players and better experiences through the game time. Here's the full detailed list:

NEW SCENES

The Game got new scenes! This includes new parts that weren't in the base game and chapter reworks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/bb1024b0799f8b7c2b5f46d7a777fa258d2ca87c.png
Chapter 4, The Explorer

This includes new puzzles & horror scenes - making the game more versatile with less repetitive scenes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/93964c166414a645cc6ef9ad41d503ac56c8d8b7.png
Chapter 4, The Explorer

New puzzle variations including VHS Tapes & Flashlight usage.

NEW GRAPHICS
With some criticism and the upcoming release of Dawn Of Fear, we also remastered all in-game scenes with better lightning, post processing & optimization. Take a look:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/f892108a77bbf755d6b2f652da2989cfe96f82e2.png
Chapter 2, Bloodlines

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/f82508b5d7958c2100a6f011111d5bb452172ab0.png
Chapter 1, The Family Prodigy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/06070983f996e73ffb2287af635d4efc2b9841dc.png
Chapter 5, Choices

NEW MECHANICS & REWORKS
We also changed the core gameplay in some parts, including new mechanics and reworks - here's the full list:

Draggable Flashlight
Now the players can use the flashlight as their own friend to discover hidden stuff and solve the puzzles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/191cdb5594be8d088563b676d2371d5bf1a070e8.png
Chapter 2, Bloodlines

Floating Icons
To improve the interactions and visibility, we added the floating icons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/3e87c3444d0994067032235ac896171e03a24678.png
Chapter 4, The Explorer

Cameras System & Fully Reworked AI System
To improve the player experience on Chapter 5, we've reworked the AI system of Matthew Juniper and we've added one fully operating camera system to see where the masked man is going to.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/22aacff92f1a0f7005ccc4e43f9b22f5b7c93df0.png
Chapter 5, Choices

Puzzle Reworks
We removed some unnecessary puzzles that were present in game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/4ae49655398a93bfb724244572ceacc0d245931a.png
Chapter 2, Bloodlines

Player Changes
We also changed the core gameplay of the player. Here's the full list of changes:


Increased the running speed of the player.
Removed the option to jump.
Removed running on Apartment & Cafe (dreams)
New tutorials for the controls


This improves the quality of the gameplay.

BUG FIXES
We also fixed some bugs that were present in the last version (1.0.6), here's the Hotfix:

Fixed the Controller Input (Thanks to QuByte Interactive!)
Fixed some translation Issues including subtitles
Fixed item names
Fixed the doors position when loading game
Fixed some broken models
Fixed the cutscene duration when leaving the house (Chapter 2)
Fixed some positions where the player could get stuck
Fixed the Inventory saving
Fixed some frame drops
Fixed some issues when crouching
Fixed the possibility to get wrong positions on examine
Fixed the dynamic audio settings
Synced the subtitles on cutscenes
Fixed some wrong colliders
Fixed some LOD issues
Fixed the sensibility settings
Fixed the objectives
Fixed cutscene sounds
Fixed wrong interaction titles
Fixed the blur on chapter 5


THE UPDATE WILL BE COMPLETELY FREE

We hope that you players enjoy the update of the experience. Feel free to follow us on social medias and join our Discord Server!

https://linktr.ee/blackhawkgames

- BHWK

notes.title: Introducing Dawn Of Fear
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2886490/Dawn_Of_Fear/

Hello Everyone! We're finally introducing our new project called Dawn Of Fear! - One survival horror project which the player Experience an intense survival horror journey as a investigative agent in a dark and cursed village. The quest for a leader has never been so hindered.

5 MINUTES OF GAMEPLAY

[previewyoutube=tFshHOp--XQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is still in work in progress, so a lot of things will be changed.

GAME HIGHLIGHTS

- First Person Action Shooter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922940/01680096efabea145df308ec25ac0f695aa573d3.png

In this possessed village, there are a lot of cult followers, so stay safe!

- Huge Variety of Enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922940/e40ac9e0f927319e5625dd64b44e70deae1459af.png

From normal possessed villagers to some side bosses to the main enemies.

- Open world exploration with side puzzles (For each chapter)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922940/61ad41dc73e51665c04628cc81ab7a35d4bc30d3.png

For each chapter, the game will contain at least one open world scene including:
 - Side Bosses
 - Treasures
 - Optional Loot

RELEASING PLANS

We plan to release the game with 1 chapter only.
The other chapters will be available by DLC, so expect the price to be low for each part.

We'll discuss later about events so tune in our X/discord server here:

https://linktr.ee/blackhawkgames

- BHWK

notes.title: The Future of Beyond The Evil
notes.content:
Hello Everyone. Sorry for the long time without any news, but we're finally revealing a lot of infos about the game, including the final release date, chapters, testing and pricing.

So let's start with the basic stuff:

FINAL RELEASE DATE AND PRICING

We think that the game will be completely finished in June 2023, because we'll have more time for test, polish and finish the project the way we want. We don't want one unsuccessful launch like our other project, NECROSIS: RECONFIGURATED.

--

About the pricing of the game, we plan to release at the cost of $18.99 (R$36,99 in Brazil). We think the cost fit the time spent on the project.

We hope everyone understands our decisions and if there're any other suggestions, please contact us in our discord server!

ABOUT THE GAME CHAPTERS

The game will have 5 Chapters and 10 Scenes to Explore. The Full Info is in the image:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/fdb711142e3ea46685846eac3b4a901fc32c625c.jpg

The game playtime is about 5 hours.

GAME TESTING

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/7312071e8b881cda0f110ee11babc231a392c879.png

We'll open again one streamers closed test to increase the game visibility and to help us finding errors in the scenes. The full announcement will be available in January 2023. The Content of the Test build will be Chapters 1-4.

--

Also, our partners will get the game available 2 Weeks before the official release to help us finish all the stuff.

OTHER QUESTIONS

 - The Game will only launch with the English Language, but will have one free Update including the Portuguese Language.

 - The Game Full Size will be about 20GB.
 
 - There will be multiple choices in the final of the game.
 
 - The game will have achievements and hidden stuff to find.

 - There will be a New Game+ in the game, you will be able to select the chapter to start, to help finding all the hidden objects.

 - The Chapter 02 (Demo Scene) will be changed a bit, and one Demo 2.0 Will be released with new puzzles and cutscenes.

- BlackHawk Games.

notes.title: INTRODUCING BEYOND THE EVIL
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We from BlackHawk Games are very happy to announce that our newest game is on Steam!

INTRODUCING BEYOND THE EVIL

Beyond the Evil is an action horror game that places the player to a hard experience to find who created the plague that doomed the world.

How big the game will be?

The game will be composed by five chapters, giving more than 8 scenes to explore!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/183971b9fb72ed588c0fe20aa58c76f3e0f9e6ed.png

The forest, from chapter 01 - The Prologue.

When the game is going to be launched?

We don't really have one fixed launch date, we will advice when the release date is ready. (Expected to be later than 2021)

Other informations:

We are going to do some closed beta tests to the game each month, starting on June 30.
We believe that if we make some closed tests of the game, will be easier to avoid some errors and glitchs from the game on the Official Launch.
More info about that will be discussed on the Discord Server.
Join Our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/wcnPScbg2S
